title: ygjson sources
description: sources.json: the snapshot of each source the committed data was imported from. Each importer records its own; build.py copies it into every release file's meta.sources.

ygoprodeck.description: YGOPRODeck's checkDBVer.php as import_ygoprodeck read it.

ygojson.description: The commit of YGOJSON's v1/aggregate branch import_ygojson read, and the increment its meta.json gives. import_ygojson downloads this commit when the cache holds another.

tcgcsv.description: The latest modifiedOn among the TCGCSV groups import_tcgcsv read.

yugipedia.description: The Yugipedia pages cached, and the UTC day the newest of them was fetched.
